gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that {@link SummaryStatistics#setMeanImpl} lets the caller replace the built-in mean calculation with a custom {@link StorelessUnivariateStatistic}. <p
ADDED i2: The mean must match the reference value exactly, so no tolerance is allowed.
ADDED i3: Override the mean implementation with one that accumulates the sum.
ADDED i4: Since the mean implementation now sums, getMean() should equal the total (1+2+3+4 = 10).
ADDED i5: Test-only {@link StorelessUnivariateStatistic} whose "result" is the running sum of every value it receives. It is used purely to override the default mean calc
ADDED i6: Running sum of the values supplied via {@link #increment(double)}.
